g.text: In-page find — shortcut ⟶ highlighted matches (CSS Custom Highlight API)
only if a query is remembered
(materialize PDF text layers · drain a stream)
count too — a re-collect can change it
No DOM mutation: matches are painted as live Ranges via the CSS Custom
A second payoff: CSS.highlights.set is not a mutation, so painting cannot
re-trigger the MutationObserver that watches for a changed document.
If unsupported, find degrades to no-op — the document is never altered.
